figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id), b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_id,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.gross,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) gmroi FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id ORDER BY gmroi DESC
